cases.title: Model facts recorded: algorithm, version, schema, window, threshold, calibration, runtime versions
cases.expected: IsolationForest, 47-feature schema, 5 s window / 1 s stride, threshold and calibration text present, trained == runtime versions
cases.actual: default=cr005-iforest-v2; v2: IsolationForest x200, uses 25/47 features, threshold=0.5813, policy={'consecutive': 5, 'hysteresis': 0.02}, sklearn 1.9.1

cases.title: Unknown or external model names are refused (no arbitrary joblib loading)
Same inputs and a freshly loaded model give bit-identical scores
cases.input: 151 windows scored twice by two model instances

cases.title: Incomplete, gapped, stale and unsupported windows produce no score; a short sensor loss is reported as coverage, not zero
cases.input: crafted windows from a real stream
cases.expected: INSUFFICIENT_DATA without score for the four; READY with coverage<1 and finite features for 1 s loss
cases.actual: {"normal (cold, mid-trip)": ["NORMAL", null, 1.0], "incomplete (3 s of data)": ["INSUFFICIENT_DATA", "time/session/sequence_gap", null], "gap in sequence": ["INSUFFICIENT_DATA", "time/session/sequence_gap", null], "stale MAF": ["INSUFFICIENT_DATA", "sensor_coverage", 1.0], "unsupported MAF": ["INSUFFICIENT_DATA", "sensor_coverage", 1.0], "1 s sensor loss in the window": ["READY", null, 0.8076923076923077]}

cases.title: No future leakage: windows ending before the injection are bit-identical to the no-fault trip
cases.input: same seed, S02 injected at 60 s vs no injection
cases.expected: all windows ending < 60 s identical; first difference after 60 s
cases.actual: 60 earlier windows identical=True; first differing window ends at 61000

cases.title: Scenario/fault labels in sample metadata do not change the model score
cases.input: same samples with phase/provenance/raw set to fault names

cases.title: Window-level separability (ROC AUC) of fault windows vs normal windows, per scenario
cases.input: dataset-3 test windows (characterization; this split informed the v2 default decision, so not independent)
cases.expected: informational: AUC > 0.5 means the score ranks fault windows higher
cases.notes: AUC near 0.5 or below means the model cannot rank that scenario's windows; see ml-eval for operational detection.

cases.title: Gradual (S01) and sudden (S05) changes: score trajectory vs threshold
cases.input: peak score and first anomalous window per model
cases.actual: S01 gradual thermal / cr004-iforest-v1: peak 0.623 at 5.0s vs thr 0.565 first-anom 147.0; S01 gradual thermal / cr005-iforest-v2: peak 0.62 at 62.0s vs thr 0.581 first-anom 61.0; S05 sudden voltage / cr004-iforest-v1: peak 0.661 at 97.0s vs thr 0.565 first-anom 60.0; S05 sudden voltage / cr005-iforest-v2: peak 0.651 at 62.0s vs thr 0.581 first-anom 60.0

cases.title: XAI: deterministic, varies with the window, equals an independent recomputation from the pipeline
cases.input: explain the same anomalous window twice, another window, and recompute counterfactual scores directly
cases.expected: identical for the same window; different for another; |difference| < 1e-12

cases.title: Previously 'always zero' SPEED group: is it a real non-effect or an aggregation/display bug?
cases.input: inspect the model's selected columns and the explanation output
cases.expected: v1 never reads SPEED features (design), explanation flags used_by_model=false; v2 reads them
cases.actual: v1 reads 12 features, SPEED features read=[]; explanation says used=False effect=0.0; v2 reads SPEED features=[4, 6]
cases.notes: Conclusion: not a bug; the feature subset excluded SPEED. The display now marks it 'not read by this model'.

cases.title: No explanation for insufficient data, another model's result or inconsistent features
Rule event at 68.2 s links the ML window that ended at 68.0 s (200 ms earlier)
cases.input: S01 at 60 s, real Session, default model
cases.expected: status window_end=68000, age=200 ms, detection=68200; report says rules detected and AI analyzed

cases.title: Linking states: exact/old/none/insufficient; age limit 2000 ms; other session and future windows never linked
cases.expected: state per case as expected; every age/session/future check true
cases.actual: states={'exact (68.0 vs 68.2)': 'ANALYZED_NORMAL', '200 ms older': 'ANALYZED_ANOMALOUS', 'no analysis available': 'NO_RECENT_ANALYSIS', 'insufficient window': 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA'}; checks={'2000 ms old': True, '2001 ms old': True, 'other session': True, 'future window not returned': True, 'before first window': True}

cases.title: Session itself does not re-check analysis age (defence in depth)
cases.input: stub analyzer returns an analysis ended 8.2 s before the event
cases.expected: ideal: Session refuses a stale analysis even if an analyzer implementation returns it
cases.actual: Session linked it: state=ANALYZED_NORMAL links=[('e', 'sess', 60000)]; the age limit is enforced only inside AnomalyAnalyzer.latest_before (verified in QA-AI-LINK-002)
cases.notes: Not a defect with the shipped analyzer; a future analyzer implementation without the age check would link stale results.

cases.title: AI unavailable cases carry the right state: disabled / model not loaded / inference failed (rules keep working)
cases.input: Session with no analyzer, with ai_failure, with a raising analyzer
cases.expected: DISABLED / MODEL_NOT_LOADED / INFERENCE_FAILED and MS_THERMAL still detected

cases.title: AI detects first, rules confirm later: reported as 'both', with later rule evidence labelled as later
cases.expected: detection_summary combined, text 'AI and rules together', later-evidence sentence present

cases.title: A rules-only event is never presented as 'detected by AI'
cases.input: S01 event with a normal AI analysis
cases.expected: detection_summary.ml false; text says rules detected

cases.title: Report: no anomaly-factor text for a normal AI decision; for an anomalous one only computed positive groups, from a window not after detection
cases.input: S01 (normal AI) and S02 with v1 (anomalous AI)
cases.expected: no 'العوامل' line for normal; shown groups subset of positive computed effects; xai.end_ms <= detection
cases.actual: normal_text_has_factors=False; anomalous shown=['air_fuel_operation', 'temperature', 'voltage'] positive=['air_fuel_operation', 'temperature', 'voltage'] xai_end=63000 detection=63000
